built_baseline.fact: Approximately 2.5 km from Zhichun Road to Qinghua East Road opened in 2023.
built_baseline.design_response: Treat retained rail, rainwater, under-bridge and cross-city public space as an existing asset; audit and add service/accountability interfaces instead of claiming duplicate landscape construction.

public_consultation_draft.status: official public consultation draft; not final approved vector
public_consultation_draft.structure: one belt, one axis, two centres and multiple nodes
public_consultation_draft.proposal_overlay: one civic spine, three verandas, six gates and twelve scenarios as a public-service and accountability layer
public_consultation_draft.excluded_from_submission_metrics: Draft-scope population, land, floor-area, facility and transport figures are not substituted for submission metrics.

carry_forward: chief planner and responsible engineer review
delivery_governance.claim_limit: No current organization is assigned, participating or endorsing until written confirmation.

planning_alignment.geometry_rule: Do not digitize the infographic as an official redline; replace provisional geometry only with rights-cleared final GIS/CAD from the competent authority.

operations_ledger.daily: opening, accessibility, notice, staffed fallback and incident check
operations_ledger.monthly: maintainer salon; review unresolved repairs and dissent
operations_ledger.quarterly: publish gate, stop, appeal and repair receipts; decide continue/revise/retire
operations_ledger.annual: Open Veranda Week plus public asset and licence audit
operations_ledger.funding_rule: no smart layer opens without a named maintenance window, spare/replacement plan and funded staffed fallback
operations_ledger.brand_rule: mark and templates may be reused with attribution; public status colours and AI-generated-content labels must not be removed
operations_ledger.version_rule: every spatial/data/operations change receives a dated public change record; unknown remains UNKNOWN

implementation_verdict.now: Concept review, official-source reconciliation, six-gate field audit and owner/rights mapping can begin.
implementation_verdict.next: A low-tech civic baseline and one reversible 90-day Veranda Receipt pilot may proceed only after named owners and gate evidence exist.
implementation_verdict.not_ready: Rail crossings, bridges/tunnels, permanent buildings, statutory indicators and capital budgets are not implementation-ready.

everyday_civic_brief.workplace_observation: Xuezhiyuan Station, Changping Line, Xueqing Road / Yuequan Road; not the park front door
everyday_civic_brief.phase1_park: Zhichun Road to Qinghua East Road along the old Jing-Zhang linear space
everyday_civic_brief.named_lunch_gate: west end of Qinghua East Road; also Zhichun Road, North Fourth Ring under-bridge, Chengfu Road / Wudaokou
pedestrian_defects: narrow sidewalks on Xueqing Road as workplace observation
high planters on Xueqing Road as workplace observation

park_program.separated_run_and_walk: separate only where verified clear width permits; keep accessible walking continuous
park_program.basketball_baseline: audit the two reported existing Phase 1 courts first
park_program.additional_courts: none by default; consider only a reversible addition after demand, noise, lighting, clear-width, access and operating audits
park_program.spectator: standing runoff plus flat benches outside safety clearance; no grandstand

ai_intents: contact a staffed help desk for a separated child without photo upload or facial recognition by default
register and collect a lost item through human verification
everyday_civic_brief.claim_limit: Not a pedestrian survey, measured Xuezhiyuan-to-park route, sports-facility approval or government endorsement. Xuezhiyuan Station is workplace context only.

geography_review.true_spine: Beijing North—Dazhongsi—Zhichun Road—Wudaokou—Qinghua East Road—North Fifth Ring
geography_review.excluded_core_anchor: Xuezhiyuan is an off-corridor lived observation, not a park gate
geography_review.movement_rule: active rail exclusive; walk continuous; run/cycle separate only where width permits; city-street cycle bypass; service vehicles time- and speed-controlled; activity pockets off through-flow
geography_review.sports_rule: audit two existing basketball courts first; no duplication without demand/noise/width/operations evidence

dual_state_plan.concept: same real geographic base, paired AI_ON and AI_OFF spatial states
dual_state_plan.independent_development: No peer narrative, schema, figure, geometry or data is copied; this package develops a spatial plan-pair method from its existing closable-AI principle.
invariants: operating rail safety edge remains exclusive
static wayfinding and staffed help remain

key_area_pairs.ai_off: staffed help, water, rest, toilet wayfinding and transfer

dual_state_plan.field_status: not authorized, not surveyed, not run
